methods.exact: SHA-256 of nontrivial complete source files.
methods.normalized: 16 consecutive nontrivial lines after comment and whitespace removal; at least 240 characters.
methods.ast: Exact identifier/literal-free TypeScript/JavaScript subtree hashes of at least 60 nodes.
methods.rareTerms: Long identifiers and strings used only to route candidates to manual review; values are not stored in this committed summary.

manualResult.trigger: Two rare identifiers and three rare strings; zero exact, normalized, token or AST match.
manualResult.review: Both programs parse the same public Codex JSONL protocol. Manual structural review found different control flow, output models and implementation structure; the shared terms are protocol field/type names.

manualResult.trigger: Two rare identifiers and two rare strings; zero exact, normalized, token or AST match.

exclusions: Dependencies, vendored code, build output, generated content, lockfiles, source maps and minified files.
LICENSE, NOTICE and COPYING texts whose mandated verbatim similarity is not source-copying evidence.
Fingerprints appearing more than eight times in the target, treated as framework or syntax boilerplate.
The audit scripts under scripts/compliance, so the audit does not compare its own new implementation.
falsePositiveCorrection: An earlier dry run treated decorative comment separators as token matches. The tokenizer was corrected to remove block, line and HTML comments; those candidates disappeared in the final run.
scopeLimit: This result applies only to the 20 pinned repositories and four target snapshots. It is not an internet-wide originality guarantee or a legal conclusion. No source snippets, matched literals, transcript bodies or credentials are committed.
